summary: Ten-metre corner kerb at a junction, steep, with homes 11 to 13 m off.
reasons: Only 10 m, under a van length

drivers.seclusion: Detached homes 11 m and 13 m away on the same side, others close round.
drivers.access_and_room: Sealed road; the stretch is a short bend beside a junction, too short for a van to stop clear.
drivers.convention: No parked cars seen; no camping convention.

sun_shade: Large tree canopy covers the kerb, mostly from the east and south.

best_section.where: North kerb just past the junction on Dennis Street
